CFPBootstrap.method: Exact dyadic CFP inputs; exact-integer Racah coefficients enclosed by Arb; validated projector and Gram residuals; spectral-gap-one projection and polar-normalization perturbation bounds. No floating residual is used as a proof bound.

statement: No pure order-8 anticoherent state on 29 symmetric qubits exists. Therefore the maximum pure-state AC order is at most 7.
